description: PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_ErrorCollector' for collecting and formatting HTML purification errors, including error structuring and HTML output generation.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ErrorCollector
classes.description: Class for collecting, structuring, and formatting errors encountered during HTML purification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the error collector with a given context, setting locale and error stacks.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Records an error message with severity, message, and context-specific substitutions; structures error data.

methods.name: getRaw
methods.description: Returns raw error data for custom formatting.

methods.name: getHTMLFormatted
methods.description: Generates HTML formatted error report, recursively rendering error structures.

methods.name: _renderStruct
methods.description: Recursively renders error structures into HTML strings for display.
